dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます。朝倉様」
出席簿をもった暦先生が、俺を見下ろしている。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei was holding the class register, staring down
at me.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei was holding the class register, staring down
at me.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「授業だ。もう終わったけどな」
dialogues.en:
"Class is still on. If you want to sleep, wait a few more
minutes for it to end."
dialogues.text:
"Class is still on. If you want to sleep, wait a few more
minutes for it to end."

dialogues.jp: 出席簿片手に、暦先生が教壇に戻っていく。
dialogues.en:
Holding the register in one hand,Koyomi-sensei returned to
her desk.
dialogues.text:
Holding the register in one hand,Koyomi-sensei returned to
her desk.

dialogues.jp:
週番の号令を聞きながら、俺は｛あくび／欠伸｝をかみ殺し
た……。
dialogues.en:
If I yawn while the weekly duty is doing his stuff, she'd
kill me for sure...
dialogues.text:
If I yawn while the weekly duty is doing his stuff, she'd
kill me for sure...

dialogues.jp:
いつの間にか、２時限目の授業――終わってた
んだな……。
dialogues.en: And the usual two-period class then ended...
dialogues.text: And the usual two-period class then ended...

dialogues.en: I had a dream of Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I had a dream of Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 環が、俺を優しく起こしてくれる夢だ……。
dialogues.en: One where she was gently waking me up...
dialogues.text: One where she was gently waking me up...
